newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL Energy sees Maui shr of 6.3m barrels.
newsitem.headline: FCL Energy sees Maui shr of 6.3m barrels.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Energy said on Monday its share of oil production from the Maui offshore field is now forecast to be 6.3 million barrels for the year ended June 30.
The company said analysis of the performance of the producing zone in the 2 D-Sand wells was producing encouraging results.
It said it was likely the Maui joint venture would be in a position to decide on further D-Sand oil development by about November this year.

"This development could involve the drilling of at least two new wells from the Maui B platform. If successful the first incremental oil production from these wells, offsetting the anticipated natural decline in the field, will commence in late calendar 1998," the company said in a statement to the NZ Stock Exchange.
